filer_ein.description: Filer's 9-digit EIN. XML emits as concatenated 9 digits ('131635294'); PDF renders as '13-1635294'. Normalize by stripping the hyphen for matching.

filer_name.description: Filer business name line 1 (e.g., 'UNITED WAY WORLDWIDE').

tax_period_end_date.description: Last day of the tax period, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Note that calendar-year filers use 12-31; some use other fiscal year-ends.

grant_records_maintained.description: Schedule I Part I line 1: does the organization maintain records to substantiate grant amounts, eligibility, and selection criteria? Output null when Part I line 1 is not visible on the form.

total_501c3_org_count.description: Schedule I Part II line 2: total count of section 501(c)(3) organization recipients listed.

total_other_org_count.description: Schedule I Part II line 3: total count of other (non-501(c)(3)) organization recipients listed.

grants.description: Every recipient organization or government that received aggregate grants > $5,000 from the filer during the tax year. Order on the IRS form is filer-defined (usually alphabetical or by amount); not significant for grading.

recipient_name.description: Recipient name, line 1 (e.g., '2-1-1 BIG BEND INC'). May be a person's name when the recipient is a sole-proprietor non-profit.

recipient_name_continuation.description: Recipient name line 2 (continuation). Always null when the data source provides the full name on one line — even if the IRS form physically wraps it across two visible lines, put the full name in recipient_name and leave this null.

address_line1.description: Recipient mailing address line 1 (e.g., 'PO BOX 10950', '1007 PATHFINDER WAY').

zip_code.description: ZIP code. XML emits as concatenated digits ('32302', '201911575'); PDF renders 5-digit or ZIP+4 with hyphen ('20191-1575'). Normalize before matching.

recipient_ein.description: Recipient's 9-digit EIN. May be null when the recipient is a government entity or unidentified individual. PDF renders with hyphen; XML without.

irc_section.description: IRC section under which the recipient is exempt (e.g., '501(C)(3)', 'GOVERNMENT ENTITY'). Free-form string.

cash_grant_amount.description: Cash grant amount in whole US dollars. XML stores as nonneg integer with no commas; PDF renders with commas.

noncash_assistance_amount.description: Noncash assistance value in whole dollars. Often 0.

noncash_assistance_description.description: Description of noncash assistance, when noncash_assistance_amount > 0.

purpose_of_grant.description: Stated purpose, free-form (e.g., 'HEALTH', 'EDUCATION', 'GENERAL OPERATING SUPPORT', 'CAPACITY BUILDING'). Customers care about this field for thematic analysis.
